availability_note: Same Route 133 sail-lane party (gate<=68 pool-84 entries; Landorus and Tapu Fini are reachable legends). Nothing from Underwater/Seafloor maps.

attempts.note: Player error T1: Fake Out into Gengar (Ghost-immune). Incineroar ended at 17/332, Flutter Mane at 86/213.

strategy_checks.check: Gengar attacks or Icy Winds turn 1
strategy_checks.evidence: T1 Sludge Bomb into Urshifu (217); T2 at 1 HP (Sash) Shadow Ball at Urshifu, beaten by Sucker Punch. Cursed Body disabled Wicked Blow on T1.

strategy_checks.check: Carracosta attacks or Wide Guards against a real spread threat
strategy_checks.evidence: No spread move was on my board; Carracosta chose Waterfall into Incineroar (2x) T1-T2 and Aqua Jet T3 to try to finish it at 95 HP. Wide Guard never selected, correctly.
Knock Off removed the Rock Gem on T2 (crack line); Carracosta died to Close Combat on T3 without using Rock Slide.

strategy_checks.check: Aromatisse Helping Hand / Wish support for Rotom-Frost
strategy_checks.evidence: T3 Moonblast KOed Urshifu (4x); T4 Moonblast at Landorus; T5 Helping Hand into Rotom-Frost's Blizzard (Rotom died before moving). Wish never used - it was never at a deficit that Wish could fix.
T4 Blizzard at Landorus (4x; Protected, spread hit Flutter Mane for 106); T5 Blizzard at Landorus again. Both hit.

protect_ledger.entry: No opponent Protect used. Gengar at 1 HP facing a faster Sucker Punch line did not Protect on T2 - arguable, but Protect would only have delayed it one turn, so recorded as a non-defect.

cooler: Four independent threats worked as a change of pace: Waterfall/Aqua Jet, a Sash Gengar that forced a priority read, and a 4x Blizzard that forced a Protect. One faint but Incineroar was at 17 HP and it was a real fight, so levels stay. Cooler idea (not this pass): Carracosta would be more menacing with Shell Smash than Aqua Jet, but the author's 'no setup' premise is a deliberate choice.
authored_set_legality: No problem; all four sets played as written (Rotom-Frost L84 at offset 2).
